title: REQ · gridToRgba converts a palette-indexed grid to RGBA and rejects out-of-range indices
summary: Pure gridToRgba returns RGBA pixels using only palette colours and throws on bad indices
description: Context: no gridToRgba exists under game/. Desired behaviour: gridToRgba(grid, palette = PALETTE) takes rows of palette indices and returns {width, height, data} where data is a Uint8ClampedArray of length width*height*4 with alpha 255. Expected result: every pixel RGB equals a palette colour; any index that is not an integer in 0..palette.length-1, or a ragged row, throws. Why: art is authored as palette-indexed grids.
acceptance_criteria: Given a 3x2 grid of valid indices, when gridToRgba runs, then width is 3, height is 2 and data length is 24
Given a valid grid, when each pixel is read back, then its RGB equals the hex colour of the palette entry at that index with alpha 255
Given an index equal to palette.length, a negative index or a non-integer, when gridToRgba runs, then it throws an Error naming the index
Given rows of unequal length or an empty grid, when gridToRgba runs, then it throws
technical_constraints: Pure function; reads colours only from the shared palette passed in (default PALETTE from game/frontend/src/lib/palette.ts)
Palette of at most 48 colours defined once
